name: L & L Metal Fabrication Inc
old_description: We can provide a limitless range of custom fabrication options for metal products and equipment. We can produce everything from the most simple to elaborate, small or expansive. With our 30+ year experience, we have the capabilities, know-how and ability to take on projects and deliver solutions beyond our client’s expectations in a range of industries.
about:
L & L Metal Fabrication operates from a 34,000-square-foot facility in Tontitown, Arkansas. The company has over 30 years of experience in custom metal fabrication, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated.

The shop provides a broad range of metal fabrication services including press brake forming (up to 146 inches long and 1/2 inch thick), laser cutting, high-definition plasma cutting (CNC-controlled, tolerances ±0.005 in), waterjet cutting with single- and dual-head systems, grinding (vibratory, tumbling, polishing), machining, welding, punching, stamping, roll forming, saw cutting, shearing, and millwright services. It also offers design-build services to streamline installation. The facility houses four press brakes with CNC back gauges, a precision laser system, and two waterjet cutters. Typical products include bins, blower housings, cabinets, chutes, conveyor systems, food-grade stainless steel equipment, machine frames, platforms, railings, and signage.

The company serves a variety of industries, with explicit mention of food-grade stainless steel equipment for food processing applications. Other sectors are implied by product types such as industrial ductwork, machine guards, and ornamental pieces, but no specific industry verticals are named in the source material.

L & L emphasizes its bonded status, compliance with local and international safety certifications, and a design-build approach that expedites project delivery. It cites competitive pricing, modern computer-integrated equipment, and a track record of repeat customers as reasons clients choose the firm.
